questions.why: Entomology is the study of insects; the rest concern law and crime. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: In a group of 110 people, 63 like chess, 40 like carrom and 3 like both. How many like neither?
Ravi walks 9 km North, then turns left and walks 12 km. How far is Ravi from the starting point?
questions.why: The two legs are at right angles: √(9² + 12²) = 15 km. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, ?
questions.why: Each term is double the previous one minus 1: 33 x 2 - 1 = 65.

questions.q: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 924. If one number is 132, find the other.
questions.why: Product = HCF × LCM: 12 × 924 ÷ 132 = 84. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: Anil walks 3 km North, then turns right and walks 4 km. How far is Anil from the starting point?
questions.why: The two legs are at right angles: √(3² + 4²) = 5 km. GPSC-style practice item.
